headline: 強光と高温でPSIIはアンテナを失い、重炭酸イオンも抜ける
subhead: シロイヌナズナのPSIIを2.74 Åで解析。D1のHis252が内側を向き、自己切断を招く可能性がある
method_label: クライオ電顕・全体 2.74 Å

summary.question: 強い光や高温は、光合成で水を分解するタンパク質複合体PSIIを傷める。その傷が構造のどこに出るかを知りたかった。
summary.approach: 単離したPSII（C2S2型）に強い光と高温を与えてクライオ電顕で解析し、弱い光で凍らせた既存の構造と比べた。
summary.result: アンテナなどのサブユニットが外れ、電子を受け取る側の非ヘム鉄まわりに損傷があり、重炭酸イオンも失われていた。
summary.learned: D1のHis252が動き、セリンプロテアーゼ（タンパク質を切る酵素）に似た3残基の組ができて、D1を自ら切断させる可能性がある。
summary.open: この3残基の組が実際にD1を切断できるかは、まだ分かっていない。

question.quote: Photosystem II (PS II) is a large membrane-bound pigment-protein complex responsible for extracting electrons and protons from water during photosynthesis and releasing molecular oxygen into the atmosphere.
While light is required to drive the photochemical reactions, high light and high temperature can be damaging to PS II.
Our aim is to gain structural insight into the photoprotection and photodamage processes in PSII.

approach.quote: To gain insight into potential structural consequences of such conditions, we performed an exploratory study where isolated PS II complexes (C2S2) from Arabidopsis thaliana were exposed to high light and elevated temperature and employed cryo-electron microscopy for structural determination.
This resulted in a ‘high light’ structure (2.74 Å global resolution) which is compared to the published 2.44 Å structure of intact Arabidopsis-PSII vitrified under dim light conditions (control).

result.quote: The high light structure is missing several of the subunits present in the control, including the strongly bound light-harvesting antenna complexes as well as several small transmembrane and extrinsic subunits.

Beyond the loss of subunits, the clearest evidence of specific photodamage was found on the acceptor side of the D1 and D2 subunits near the non-heme iron, including the loss of the bicarbonate ligand of the non-heme iron.

learned.quote: Finally, we were able to observe that high light/elevated temperature conditions result in the movement of the D1:His252 residue, potentially forming a serine protease triad that may trigger auto-proteolysis of the D1 subunit.Supplementary InformationThe online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s11120-026-01238-w.Keywords: Photosynthesis, Photosystem II, Structure, Cryo-EM, High light, High temperature
We speculate that this may form an atypical serine-protease triad or diad (Ekici et al.

open.quote: It is currently unclear from the high light structure if the proposed serine-protease triad would be capable of auto-catalytic cleavage of D1

highlights.text: 非ヘム鉄のあるアクセプター側でD1・D2のDEループ複数箇所の密度が消え、重炭酸イオンの密度も3.0 RMSDでは見えなくなる。高光下で重炭酸が外れて光保護に働くという生化学の知見に、構造の側から補完的な証拠を与える。

evidence.quote: At a contour level of 3.0 RMSD the Coulomb potential map for the high light treated PS II complexes showed no density above the non-heme iron
Our result provides complementary structural information to the significant biophysical evidence that high light can cause the bicarbonate to dissociate from the non-heme iron

highlights.text: D1 His252がQB結合ポケット側へ回転し、Ser264・Asn266と非典型的なセリンプロテアーゼ様トライアドを作りうる位置に来る。D1の自己切断を説明する仮説だが、著者自身も距離が長く、攻撃対象も不明確で、自己触媒が可能かは不明としている。

evidence.quote: We speculate that this may form an atypical serine-protease triad or diad
It is currently unclear from the high light structure if the proposed serine-protease triad would be capable of auto-catalytic cleavage of D1

highlights.text: 単離したPSIIを光処理してから凍結することで、プロテアーゼによる分解を受けない損傷状態を捉えられる。一方、C2対称を課した平均構造なので、個々の複合体の損傷の違いや非対称な損傷は平均化される。

evidence.quote: As the PS II complexes were illuminated after isolation, proteases were largely absent so that damaged PS II complexes remained undigested
It should be noted that C2-symmetry was enforced in the generation of the cryo-EM map, therefore asymmetric damage would be averaged out across both monomers.

lab_notes.expression: シロイヌナズナ（Col-0）を8週間、20°C・8時間明/16時間暗で栽培。暗所16時間後に葉を回収。
lab_notes.construct: BBY膜からPSII C2S2複合体（強結合アンテナ付き）を単離。
lab_notes.purification: 既報の方法（Forsman et al. 2026）に従う。
lab_notes.sample_prep: 1.6 mg Chl/mLを2000 µEで30分照射。約30秒後にQuantifoil R1.2/1.3 Cu 300へ。Vitrobot Mk IV 4°C・湿度100%、ブロット5秒。
lab_notes.data_collection: Titan Krios G2＋Falcon 4＋Selectris、15,511ムービー、総線量40 e⁻/Å²。cryoSPARCでC2対称、2.74 Å。

evidence.quote: The leaves of the plants were harvested after 16 h of darkness, and BBY membranes (PS II-enriched thylakoid membrane fragments, Berthold et al. 1981)
The sample (1.6 mg Chl mL− 1) was then put into a glass vial (approx. diameter 10 mm; sample height 10 mm) and exposed to 2000 µE of light for 30 min
The grids were then plunge frozen in liquid ethane using an FEI Vitrobot MkIV (Thermo Fisher Scientific) at 100% humidity, 4 °C, a blot force of -5, a wait time of 1 s and a blotting time of 5 s.
In total 15,511 movies were collected, which each contained 40 frames.

editor_notes: 対照構造は 9I4T（既報）。PDB 31FD は未公開（released ではない）のため、PDB 由来の分解能・リガンドは取得できず、method_label に本文の値（2.74 Å）を入れた。構造図は作れない可能性が高い。探索的研究と著者自身が位置づけており、仮説（セリンプロテアーゼ様トライアド）は推測として書いた。
